body:
Real, minimal cross-org trust model for CarePyre's multi-tenant use case:
organizations table with a nullable cluster_id (one flat trust boundary per
market), org_id on local_users/mail_account_credentials/sip_accounts, and a
dedicated cross_org_access_log table for fraud/waste/abuse auditing.

Ships the exact worked example the founder gave: a Provider Operator can
password-reset a participant onboarded by a different, cluster-sharing
organization (e.g. shelter service navigator <-> health provider). Same
cluster-trust extended to mail/SIP visibility and provisioning. Backward
compatible (org 0 never shares with anything, including another 0).

New GET/POST /api/v1/organizations, PATCH /api/v1/organizations/{id}
(users.admin-gated). 9 new tests, all passing. go build/vet/test clean.
Live-verified against the running idunapro.service + real sqlite schema.

Docs: CarePyre/docs/HIPAA_COMPLIANCE_NORTHSTAR.md updated.
